name: 赤狼
rulesText: 登場時：可以公開牌組頂三張卡，從中選一張「炎獸」卡加入手牌（「赤狼」除外），其餘以任意次序置於牌組底；之後處理被公開效果。

choice.prompt: 赤狼：公開牌組頂三張卡？

en.name: Red Wolf
en.rulesText: When it enters: you may reveal the top three cards of your deck, choose one Beast card from them and add it to your hand (except Red Wolf), and put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order; then process revealed effects.
